notes.title: The official launch date of "Mortal and Divine Generals" is May 28, 2025!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear players,[/h2]

 "Immortal Legends of Mortals" officially launched on Steam at 15:30 (UTC+8) on May 28, 2025.! Start your journey to cultivate immortals now and experience the oriental mythical world of hang-up play and fierce strategic battle!

[h2]A quick overview of service opening benefits[/h2]
[olist]
[*]🔥 [Welfare 1: First VIP Gift Pack]
Enter the redemption code: VIP666, VIP888, VIP99, and receive luxury rewards now!
(Receiving method: Click on the avatar → redemption code → enter redemption)
[*]🎁 [Benefits 2: Log in for 10 minutes to get SSR God]
Get "Poison Daji" for free - exclusive SSR for a limited time, log in and get it away!
[*]💎 [Welfare 3: Break through the barrier and get 1000 draws!]
Break through the barrier and win a thousand card draws, and the divine generals and equipment are soft!
[*]🌟 [Welfare 4: SP God General · Bull Demon King Get Free!]
Pass the 380 level and directly receive the SP top god general "Pingtian Great Sage · Bull Demon King"!
[*]💌[Benefits 5: Add Q group leader's first gift package]
Official Q group: 864856116, you can get the first activation code as soon as you join the group. It will be a step faster at the beginning!
[/olist]
[h2]Praise gathering activity[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Post praise to the steam community in the game, and you can contact customer service to get a 100 yuan game gift code.
[*]If you publish more than 20 likes, you can get an additional gift package code worth 500 yuan.
[*] Other conditions: You need to play for more than 1 hour, and contact customer service to submit your own character information. Each character is limited to one copy.
[/olist]
[h2]Highlights of the core gameplay[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Hang up and play: automatically brush monsters offline, easily accumulate resources, and free your hands.
[*]Gods will gather: Dark Wukong, Doushen Prince and other four gods will be freely matched to activate element restraint.
[*]Multiple copies: single/team copies of Shura underground palace, town demon tower, etc., with equal emphasis on strategy and combat effectiveness.
[*]In-depth cultivation: God's awakening, royal soul matching, spiritual pet strange fire coordination, and the combat power exceeds the unlimited limit.
[/olist]
[h3]Let's go together: embark on the fairy road and win the three worlds![/h3]
